lineage.superseded_reason: exact-(T,outcome,cell) team-role residual was determined before target scoring to be statistically too sparse; branch remains unscored and unmodified

scientific_hypothesis.statement: After total-goals and H/D/A partition masses are fixed, the remaining score-shape information for decisive outcomes can be represented parsimoniously by a single continuous interaction between pre-match competitive balance and normalized win-margin severity. Stronger expected winners may place more probability on severe wins, while upset winners may concentrate on narrow wins, without changing total-goals or 1X2 probabilities.

constraints: preserve every frozen V3.1.1 total-goals marginal exactly
preserve frozen V3.2.4 target H/D/A probabilities exactly
canonical_target_matrix.construction: deterministic KL I-projection of frozen V3.1.1 matrix onto total-goals plus target-HDA constraints

partition_geometry.eligible: H or A partitions containing at least two finite-support score cells
partition_geometry.partition_mass_rule: preserve every canonical (T,outcome) partition mass exactly
partition_geometry.normalized_severity: for a decisive score cell, severity=(abs(home_goals-away_goals)-minimum_margin_for_that_total)/(total_goals-minimum_margin_for_that_total); minimum_margin=1 for odd total and 2 for even total; eligible partitions therefore map narrowest win to 0 and most severe win to 1

competitive_balance_signal.source: frozen pre-match V3.1.1 score matrix only
competitive_balance_signal.interpretation: x approximately zero for balanced fixtures; positive for the expected winner; negative for an upset outcome

development_only_gamma_fit.development_observations: only completed development matches whose realized outcome is H or A and whose realized (T,outcome) partition contains at least two score cells inside the frozen matrix support
development_only_gamma_fit.objective: maximize conditional exact-score log likelihood inside the realized (T,outcome) partition under q_gamma(cell|T,O) proportional to q0(cell|T,O)*exp(gamma*x_O*severity(cell)); q0 is the frozen V3.1.1 conditional partition distribution
development_only_gamma_fit.solver: deterministic one-dimensional concave MLE: solve monotone score equation by bracket expansion from gamma=0 in unit powers-of-two and bisection to absolute score tolerance 1e-12; no grid, no candidate comparison, no target-period feedback

candidate_construction.step_1: build canonical target matrix from frozen V3.1.1 plus frozen V3.2.4 HDA constraints
candidate_construction.step_2: for each eligible H/A (T,outcome) partition compute x_O from frozen V3.1.1 H/A probabilities
candidate_construction.step_3: multiply canonical cell probabilities inside that partition by exp(gamma*x_O*normalized_severity)
candidate_construction.step_4: renormalize only within the same partition back to its exact canonical partition mass
